evidence.description: merge_realized correctly distinguishes positive-same-value (skipped_dup, REQ-R4) from both-zero (noop). Closes FIND-001.
Test split: test_same_value_positive_is_skipped_dup asserts s == 'skipped_dup' and test_same_value_both_zero_is_noop asserts s == 'noop', locking REQ-R4 + EDGE-E5 semantics.
PROP-M3 test: earner (roi=100 × prob=0.01 = 1.0) beats reconciler (0 × 1.0 = 0.0) via pick_next; verifies REQ-M3 lowest-priority guarantee.

PROP-R5 crash-safety: monkeypatches os.replace to raise on the FIRST call (roi.jsonl rewrite at reconciler.py:234, before last-run.json at 253 and offset at 256). SHA-256 pre/post confirms roi.jsonl bytes unchanged. Closes FIND-003.
Multi-malformed dedup regression: 3 malformed settle lines yield 3 distinct unmatched entries. Closes FIND-004.
PROP-M3 alone-with-cadence: reconciler is picked when it's the only cadence-eligible candidate. Closes FIND-005 companion sanity.
roi.jsonl parse preserves malformed lines as {'__raw__': l} sentinels + records error index; no silent deletion. Closes FIND-002 read path.

Rewrite re-emits __raw__ verbatim: 'new_lines.append(r["__raw__"] + "\n")' with NO json.dumps re-serialization. Verified by test_reconcile_preserves_malformed_roi_line_verbatim asserting exact string match at test_reconciler.py:328.

Malformed settle rows get unique per-line key: pass_id=f'__malformed__:{offset_before+idx}' and ts=-(offset_before+idx+1) (negative, cannot collide with real unix-seconds ts). Grep of pattern '__malformed__:' confirms unique keys. Closes FIND-004.
roi_by_pass builder explicitly skips '__raw__' sentinels so best_by_pass matching operates only on valid roi rows.
Tautological ternary replaced with semantically meaningful branch ('skipped_dup' if e > 0 else 'noop'). Dead code eliminated. Closes FIND-006.
Integration test verifies dispatcher STEP-6 reconciler branch runs in-process without task enqueue; unchanged from previous iterations, still passes.
Pure core (parse_settle_line, merge_realized) is fixture-testable, no I/O, small enough for property proof.
_atomic_replace_jsonl isolates the os.replace side effect; write ordering (i)-(v) per REQ-R5 preserved at reconcile() 227-256.
PROP-I1/I2/I3/I4 static grep guards: no tmux kill, no earnings.jsonl reference, no osascript/telegram/twilio, no shell=True or os.system(. Purity boundary enforced.
